title: Definition
quote: Definition.
meaning: Defines the State for Part III: Union and state governments and legislatures, and local or other authorities within the constitutional definition.
note: Official article heading. Whether a particular body is a State authority can require a court decision.
keywords: government authority public state

title: Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights
quote: Laws inconsistent with or in derogation of the fundamental rights.
meaning: Pre-Constitution laws inconsistent with Part III, and new laws taking away its rights, are void to the extent of the inconsistency.
note: Official article heading. Constitutional amendments and judicial review involve additional constitutional rules.
keywords: invalid unconstitutional judicial review

title: Equality before law
quote: The State shall not deny to any person equality before the law or the equal protection of the laws within the territory of India.
meaning: Every person is entitled to equality before the law and equal protection of the laws.
note: Official excerpt; the summary may cover other clauses. Not every distinction is unlawful; the classification and its justification matter.
keywords: equality equal discrimination unfair

title: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth
quote: Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex or place of birth.
meaning: Protects citizens against specified discrimination by the State and in access to certain public facilities.
note: Official article heading. Clauses (3)–(6) allow specified special provisions and reservations; read their conditions.
keywords: discrimination caste religion gender sex women reservation access hotel

title: Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment
quote: Equality of opportunity in matters of public employment.
meaning: Protects equal opportunity for citizens in public employment and bars specified discrimination.
note: Official article heading. Residence requirements, reservations, promotions and other exceptions are governed by the article and applicable law.
keywords: job government employment recruitment reservation promotion

title: Abolition of Untouchability
quote: Abolition of Untouchability.
meaning: Abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form. Enforcing a disability arising from it is punishable under law.
note: Official article heading. The Protection of Civil Rights Act and other legislation supply specific offences and remedies.
keywords: untouchability dalit caste discrimination

title: Abolition of titles
quote: Abolition of titles.
meaning: Restricts state-conferred titles and acceptance of foreign titles, presents and offices in the circumstances listed.
note: Official article heading. Military and academic distinctions are expressly excepted from clause (1).
keywords: titles awards foreign distinction

title: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.
quote: Protection of certain rights regarding freedom of speech, etc.
meaning: Protects citizens’ speech and expression; peaceful assembly without arms; associations, unions and co-operative societies; movement; residence; and profession, occupation, trade or business.
note: Official article heading. These six freedoms are subject to the distinct restrictions in clauses (2)–(6). Clause (1)(f), property, is omitted.
keywords: speech expression protest assembly association union movement residence business profession press

title: Protection in respect of conviction for offences
quote: No person accused of any offence shall be compelled to be a witness against himself.
meaning: Protects against retrospective criminal conviction or a greater retrospective penalty; prosecution and punishment twice for the same offence; and compelled self-incriminating testimony by an accused.
note: Official excerpt; the summary may cover other clauses. The exact scope differs for each protection. It is not a general exemption from lawful evidence collection.
keywords: double jeopardy retrospective confession silence accused self incrimination

title: Protection of life and personal liberty
quote: No person shall be deprived of his life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
meaning: Every person has constitutional protection for life and personal liberty; deprivation must follow procedure established by law.
note: Official excerpt; the summary may cover other clauses. This foundational right does not automatically waive hospital bills. Judicial interpretation and the facts matter.
keywords: life liberty dignity privacy hospital

title: Right to education
quote: Right to education.
meaning: The State must provide free and compulsory education to children aged six to fourteen in the manner provided by law.
note: Official article heading. The Right of Children to Free and Compulsory Education Act supplies the statutory framework.
keywords: school education child free admission

title: Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases
quote: Protection against arrest and detention in certain cases.
meaning: Ordinarily an arrested person must be informed of the grounds, can consult and be defended by a chosen lawyer, and must be produced before a magistrate within 24 hours excluding necessary travel.
note: Official article heading. Clauses (1)–(2) have exceptions for enemy aliens and preventive detention. Clauses (4)–(7) contain a separate preventive-detention framework; this is not automatic release at 24 hours.
keywords: arrest custody lawyer detention grounds magistrate 24 hours

title: Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour
quote: Prohibition of traffic in human beings and forced labour.
meaning: Prohibits trafficking, begar and similar forced labour, with contraventions punishable by law.
note: Official article heading. Non-discriminatory compulsory service for public purposes is allowed by clause (2).
keywords: trafficking forced labour bonded slavery work

title: Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc.
quote: Prohibition of employment of children in factories, etc.
meaning: A child below fourteen cannot work in a factory or mine or in other hazardous employment.
note: Official article heading. Child-labour statutes provide additional rules; do not treat this article as permission for all other child work.
keywords: child labour factory mine hazardous

title: Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion
quote: Freedom of conscience and free profession, practice and propagation of religion.
meaning: All persons have freedom of conscience and to profess, practise and propagate religion.
note: Official article heading. Subject to public order, morality, health, other Part III rights and the regulatory and reform provisions in clause (2).
keywords: religion conscience worship faith

title: Freedom to manage religious affairs
quote: Freedom to manage religious affairs.
meaning: Religious denominations can establish religious or charitable institutions, manage religious affairs, own property and administer it according to law.
note: Official article heading. Subject to public order, morality and health; property administration remains subject to law.
keywords: religious denomination institution temple mosque church

title: Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion
quote: Freedom as to payment of taxes for promotion of any particular religion.
meaning: No person can be compelled to pay a tax specifically appropriated to promoting or maintaining a particular religion or denomination.
note: Official article heading. Whether a levy is a tax of this kind requires legal analysis.
keywords: religious tax taxation

title: Freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions
quote: Freedom as to attendance at religious instruction or religious worship in certain educational institutions.
meaning: Limits religious instruction in wholly state-funded institutions and protects against compelled religious instruction or worship in recognised or aided institutions without the required consent.
note: Official article heading. Clause (2) has an endowment or trust exception; for a minor, clause (3) refers to guardian consent.
keywords: school religion instruction worship consent

title: Protection of interests of minorities
quote: Protection of interests of minorities.
meaning: Any section of citizens with a distinct language, script or culture can conserve it. Citizens have protection against specified discrimination in admission to state-maintained or aided institutions.
note: Official article heading. Clause (1) is framed for any section of citizens; admission protections must be read with other constitutional provisions.
keywords: language script culture minority admission

title: Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions
quote: Right of minorities to establish and administer educational institutions.
meaning: Religious and linguistic minorities may establish and administer educational institutions of their choice.
note: Official article heading. Includes acquisition and non-discrimination-in-aid protections; regulation and constitutional case law matter.
keywords: minority school college institution religious linguistic

title: Compulsory acquisition of property
quote: Compulsory acquisition of property.
meaning: This former fundamental-right provision was omitted. See Article 300A for the constitutional protection of property.
note: Official article heading. Omitted by the Forty-fourth Amendment with effect from 20 June 1979. It is not a current fundamental right.
keywords: property omitted repealed acquisition

title: Saving of laws providing for acquisition of estates, etc.
quote: Saving of laws providing for acquisition of estates, etc.
meaning: Protects specified classes of laws, including certain estate acquisitions, against challenges under Articles 14 and 19, subject to conditions.
note: Official article heading. This is a saving clause, not an extra individual right. Read the presidential-assent and compensation provisos.
keywords: estate acquisition land reform saving

title: Validation of certain Acts and Regulations
quote: Validation of certain Acts and Regulations.
meaning: Provides constitutional protection for legislation listed in the Ninth Schedule.
note: Official article heading. A saving clause, not an individual right. Do not assume Ninth Schedule placement eliminates all constitutional judicial review.
keywords: ninth schedule validation judicial review

title: Saving of laws giving effect to certain directive principles
quote: Saving of laws giving effect to certain directive principles.
meaning: Concerns protection of laws giving effect to the policy in Article 39(b) or (c) against specified fundamental-right challenges.
note: Official article heading. The official edition records struck-down text and the invalid extension to all Part IV principles. Read its footnotes and relevant judgments; a printed bracketed amendment is not necessarily operative.
keywords: directive principles resources wealth saving

title: Saving of laws in respect of anti-national activities
quote: Saving of laws in respect of anti-national activities.
meaning: This former provision has been omitted.
note: Official article heading. Omitted by the Forty-third Amendment with effect from 13 April 1978. Not a current power or right.
keywords: omitted anti national

title: Remedies for enforcement of rights conferred by this Part
quote: The right to move the Supreme Court by appropriate proceedings for the enforcement of the rights conferred by this Part is guaranteed.
meaning: Guarantees access to the Supreme Court through appropriate proceedings to enforce Part III rights; includes constitutional writs.
note: Official excerpt; the summary may cover other clauses. The appropriate forum and remedy depend on the case. Article 226 also concerns High Court writ jurisdiction.
keywords: writ habeas corpus mandamus certiorari prohibition quo warranto supreme court

title: Constitutional validity of State laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 32
quote: Constitutional validity of State laws not to be considered in proceedings under article 32.
meaning: This former restriction on Article 32 proceedings has been omitted.
note: Official article heading. Omitted by the Forty-third Amendment with effect from 13 April 1978.
keywords: omitted state laws validity

title: Power of Parliament to modify the rights conferred by this Part in their application to Forces, etc.
quote: Power of Parliament to modify the rights conferred by this Part in their application to Forces, etc.
meaning: Parliament may restrict or abrogate specified rights for the armed forces and other listed services to ensure duties and discipline.
note: Official article heading. Only the constitutional classes and statutory measures actually applicable determine the restriction.
keywords: army armed forces police intelligence discipline

title: Restriction on rights conferred by this Part while martial law is in force in any area
quote: Restriction on rights conferred by this Part while martial law is in force in any area.
meaning: Allows Parliament to indemnify specified actions and validate certain acts connected with martial law.
note: Official article heading. This is a constitutional qualification, not a general police power or an individual right.
keywords: martial law indemnity

title: Legislation to give effect to the provisions of this Part
quote: Legislation to give effect to the provisions of this Part.
meaning: Reserves legislation on specified Part III matters and punishment for its declared offences to Parliament.
note: Official article heading. Read the enumerated subjects and continuity rule; this is an implementing provision.
keywords: parliament legislation punishment

title: Definition
quote: Definition.
meaning: Uses the Part III definition of the State.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: definition uses the part iii definition of the state.

title: Application of the principles contained in this Part
quote: Application of the principles contained in this Part.
meaning: Directive Principles are not enforceable by a court, but are fundamental in governance and must guide lawmaking.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: application of the principles contained in this part directive principles are not enforceable by a court, but are fundamental in governance and must guide lawmaking.

title: State to secure a social order for the promotion of welfare of the people
quote: State to secure a social order for the promotion of welfare of the people.
meaning: Calls for a just social order and reduction of inequalities of income, status, facilities and opportunity.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: state to secure a social order for the promotion of welfare of the people calls for a just social order and reduction of inequalities of income, status, facilities and opportunity.

title: Certain principles of policy to be followed by the State
quote: Certain principles of policy to be followed by the State.
meaning: Covers adequate livelihood; resources for the common good; avoiding harmful concentration of wealth; equal pay for men and women; workers’ health; and children’s dignity and development.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: certain principles of policy to be followed by the state covers adequate livelihood; resources for the common good; avoiding harmful concentration of wealth; equal pay for men and women; workers’ health; and children’s dignity and development.

title: Equal justice and free legal aid
quote: Equal justice and free legal aid.
meaning: Directs equal access to justice and legal aid so economic or other disability does not deny justice.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: equal justice and free legal aid directs equal access to justice and legal aid so economic or other disability does not deny justice.

title: Organisation of village panchayats
quote: Organisation of village panchayats.
meaning: Directs the organisation and empowerment of village panchayats as self-government units.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: organisation of village panchayats directs the organisation and empowerment of village panchayats as self-government units.

title: Right to work, to education and to public assistance in certain cases
quote: Right to work, to education and to public assistance in certain cases.
meaning: Directs provision for work, education and public assistance in unemployment, old age, sickness, disablement and undeserved want, within economic capacity and development.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: right to work, to education and to public assistance in certain cases directs provision for work, education and public assistance in unemployment, old age, sickness, disablement and undeserved want, within economic capacity and development.

title: Provision for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief
quote: Provision for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief.
meaning: Directs humane working conditions and maternity relief.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: provision for just and humane conditions of work and maternity relief directs humane working conditions and maternity relief.

title: Living wage, etc., for workers
quote: Living wage, etc., for workers.
meaning: Directs a living wage, decent life and leisure for workers and promotion of rural cottage industries.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: living wage, etc., for workers directs a living wage, decent life and leisure for workers and promotion of rural cottage industries.

title: Participation of workers in management of industries
quote: Participation of workers in management of industries.
meaning: Directs measures for workers’ participation in industrial management.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: participation of workers in management of industries directs measures for workers’ participation in industrial management.

title: Promotion of co-operative societies
quote: Promotion of co-operative societies.
meaning: Directs support for voluntary, autonomous and democratically controlled co-operative societies with professional management.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: promotion of co-operative societies directs support for voluntary, autonomous and democratically controlled co-operative societies with professional management.

title: Uniform civil code for the citizens
quote: Uniform civil code for the citizens.
meaning: Directs the State to endeavour to secure a uniform civil code throughout India.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: uniform civil code for the citizens directs the state to endeavour to secure a uniform civil code throughout india.

title: Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years
quote: Provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years.
meaning: Directs early childhood care and education until age six; Article 21A covers ages six to fourteen.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: provision for early childhood care and education to children below the age of six years directs early childhood care and education until age six; article 21a covers ages six to fourteen.

title: Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections
quote: Promotion of educational and economic interests of Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes and other weaker sections.
meaning: Directs special care for educational and economic interests and protection from social injustice and exploitation.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: promotion of educational and economic interests of scheduled castes, scheduled tribes and other weaker sections directs special care for educational and economic interests and protection from social injustice and exploitation.

title: Duty of the State to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health
quote: Duty of the State to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health.
meaning: Directs improvement in nutrition, living standards and public health, including the specified policy on intoxicants.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: duty of the state to raise the level of nutrition and the standard of living and to improve public health directs improvement in nutrition, living standards and public health, including the specified policy on intoxicants.

title: Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry
quote: Organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry.
meaning: Directs modern and scientific agriculture and animal husbandry and the specified measures for preservation of cattle.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: organisation of agriculture and animal husbandry directs modern and scientific agriculture and animal husbandry and the specified measures for preservation of cattle.

title: Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life
quote: Protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life.
meaning: Directs environmental protection and improvement and safeguarding of forests and wildlife.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: protection and improvement of environment and safeguarding of forests and wild life directs environmental protection and improvement and safeguarding of forests and wildlife.

title: Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance
quote: Protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance.
meaning: Directs protection of monuments, places and objects declared of national importance under parliamentary law.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: protection of monuments and places and objects of national importance directs protection of monuments, places and objects declared of national importance under parliamentary law.

title: Separation of judiciary from executive
quote: Separation of judiciary from executive.
meaning: Directs separation of the judiciary from the executive in state public services.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.

title: Promotion of international peace and security
quote: Promotion of international peace and security.
meaning: Directs peace, honourable international relations, respect for international law and settlement of disputes by arbitration.
note: Official article heading. Part IV is not directly enforceable by courts (Article 37); implementing legislation may create enforceable rights.
keywords: promotion of international peace and security directs peace, honourable international relations, respect for international law and settlement of disputes by arbitration.

title: Power of High Courts to issue certain writs
quote: Power of High Courts to issue certain writs.
meaning: High Courts can issue appropriate writs for fundamental rights and for other purposes within their constitutional jurisdiction.
note: Official article heading. Territorial jurisdiction, alternative remedies and procedural rules matter.
keywords: high court writ remedy

title: Persons not to be deprived of property save by authority of law
quote: No person shall be deprived of his property save by authority of law.
meaning: A person cannot be deprived of property except by authority of law. This is a constitutional protection outside Part III.
note: Official excerpt; the summary may cover other clauses. Property is no longer a Part III fundamental right. Statutory acquisition and compensation rules must also be checked.
keywords: property land house acquisition eviction

title: Elections to the House of the People and to the Legislative Assemblies of States to be on the basis of adult suffrage
quote: Elections to the House of the People and to the Legislative Assemblies of States to be on the basis of adult suffrage.
meaning: Citizens aged eighteen or above are entitled to voter registration subject to the constitutional conditions and lawful disqualifications.
note: Official article heading. This concerns the specified elections; registration, residence, disqualifications and election laws apply.
keywords: vote voting election adult suffrage

title: Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances
quote: Language to be used in representations for redress of grievances.
meaning: Every person may submit a representation for redress to a Union or state authority in any language used in the Union or the State, as applicable.
note: Official article heading. This does not guarantee every service or court proceeding in a chosen language.
keywords: language grievance representation

title: Facilities for instruction in mother-tongue at primary stage
quote: Facilities for instruction in mother-tongue at primary stage.
meaning: States and local authorities should endeavour to provide primary-stage mother-tongue instruction facilities for children belonging to linguistic minorities.
note: Official article heading. The text is an endeavour duty and also provides for presidential directions.
keywords: mother tongue language primary school

title: Special Officer for linguistic minorities
quote: Special Officer for linguistic minorities.
meaning: Provides for a Special Officer to investigate constitutional safeguards for linguistic minorities and report to the President.
note: Official article heading. This is an institutional safeguard, not a substitute for a court remedy.
keywords: linguistic minority commissioner

title: Suspension of provisions of article 19 during emergencies
quote: Suspension of provisions of article 19 during emergencies.
meaning: Specifies the effect on Article 19 of an emergency based on war or external aggression, subject to the article’s conditions.
note: Official article heading. Not every emergency suspends every right. Read the required connection and recital conditions.
keywords: emergency speech suspension

title: Suspension of the enforcement of the rights conferred by Part III during emergencies
quote: Suspension of the enforcement of the rights conferred by Part III during emergencies.
meaning: Allows specified presidential orders affecting enforcement of identified Part III rights during an emergency. Articles 20 and 21 are excluded.
note: Official article heading. Read the particular order, duration, territory and constitutional conditions. This does not suspend all rights automatically.
keywords: emergency enforcement life liberty
